image_purpose: Existing local OCR image used only as a test interpreter; private NER venv site-packages and feature source mounted readonly. Not a deployment image.

runs.name: first
runs.command: docker --host=unix:///var/run/docker.sock run --rm --name gate03c-first --network none --memory 8g --cpus 4 --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --user 1000:1000 --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=256m --mount type=bind,src=/workspace/.anonymization-venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages,dst=/opt/ner-packages,readonly --mount type=bind,src=/workspace/augmentoolkit-anonymization,dst=/app,readonly --mount type=bind,src=/workspace/.anonymization-model,dst=/models,readonly --mount type=bind,src=/workspace/gate03c-runtime-state,dst=/state --workdir /app -e PYTHONPATH=/opt/ner-packages:/app -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 -e TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 -e HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 -e PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 --entrypoint python sha256:32d30b74a9dafb3bd9acabfc5704f7000b91facb59626a494fed5cbbea0ad907 -m ocr.anonymization.staging_probe --cache /models --output /state/runtime-first.json

runs.name: native-verification
runs.command: docker --host=unix:///var/run/docker.sock run --rm --name gate03c-native-verification --network none --memory 8g --cpus 4 --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --user 1000:1000 --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=256m --mount type=bind,src=/workspace/.anonymization-venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages,dst=/opt/ner-packages,readonly --mount type=bind,src=/workspace/augmentoolkit-anonymization,dst=/app,readonly --mount type=bind,src=/workspace/.anonymization-model,dst=/models,readonly --mount type=bind,src=/workspace/gate03c-runtime-state,dst=/state --workdir /app -e PYTHONPATH=/opt/ner-packages:/app -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 -e TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 -e HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 -e PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 --entrypoint python sha256:32d30b74a9dafb3bd9acabfc5704f7000b91facb59626a494fed5cbbea0ad907 -m ocr.anonymization.staging_probe --cache /models --output /state/runtime-native-verification.json

observation: First/restart capture pre-observer versions by per-result source hash. Native-verification source is byte-identical to tracked commit 5653ab7. Resource measurements are cloud-only, not production-host qualification.
